caption:
🏗️ Clinic website projects tend to stall at the same step. It isn’t the design.

The usual order goes: design first, approved quickly. Then everyone waits for the words: the treatment pages, the doctor bios, how costs are described. Weeks pass with a beautiful homepage and nothing behind it.

Design should decorate substance, not hide its absence.

The order we work in:
1️⃣ Study: what patients search and what your listing shows. It arrives as a written review, free, yours to keep
2️⃣ Structure and words: page order and real copy, signed off before any design
3️⃣ Design and build: on your real content, tested on a mid-range Android
4️⃣ Launch, then stay: checked against published targets, with a monthly plan if you want one

Have these ready before you start:
• Your treatment list
• How you prefer to describe costs
• An hour to talk about your practice
• Access for photographs, or a visit

✅ Words first. Everything else gets faster.
